newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Gun ban keeps Sharon out of Israel's soccer loss.
newsitem.headline: Gun ban keeps Sharon out of Israel's soccer loss.

text.p: A ban on guns kept former general Ariel Sharon from entering a Moscow stadium to watch Israel's national soccer team do battle with Russia.

"They wouldn't let his guards go in, therefore the minister couldn't attend the match," said a spokeswoman for Sharon on Monday. Sharon, Israel's national infrastructure minister, was in Russia to discuss a natural gas deal.
Israel lost the World Cup qualifying match on Sunday 2-0.

The spokeswoman said the Israeli embassy had failed to arrange in advance for the entry of the armed guards, calling the incident in which Sharon was turned away from the stadium "a mistake stemming from lack of coordination".
